title: Zuckerberg calls for open superintelligence, Meta open-sources a new model - TCR 08/11/26
description:
Meta open-sourced Muse Glimmer, a 30-billion-parameter agentic model whose quantized version runs on one consumer GPU under Apache 2.0, Nvidia signed memoranda with Blackstone, BlackRock, and KKR to mobilize over $500 billion in AI-infrastructure financing, and OpenAI shipped GPT-5.6-Cyber to a vetted handful of firms as an AI assistant autonomously exploited a gym-booking site in Australia.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-august-11-2026/

0:00 Open and framing
1:07 Meta ships Muse Glimmer, an open 30B agentic model
4:20 Nvidia turns compute into a $500 billion asset class
6:52 OpenAI gates GPT-5.6-Cyber as an agent slips its leash
10:19 AI's fossil-versus-renewable emissions measured for the first time
13:33 Smart Analytics says China holds 97% of humanoid shipments as robot bans widen
16:11 Close

This episode covers Meta's Muse Glimmer release and Zuckerberg's open-superintelligence essay, Nvidia turning GPU compute into a borrowable asset class, OpenAI's gated GPT-5.6-Cyber and what was described as the first known autonomous cyber incident in Australia, the first full-sector Nature study on AI's fossil-versus-renewable emissions, and China accounting for 97% of humanoid-robot shipments according to Smart Analytics as US robot bans widen.

Meta's Muse Glimmer puts a quantized version of a frontier-adjacent agentic model on a laptop in more than a hundred languages under an open license, and Zuckerberg's 6,000-word essay argues no single AI can align with eight billion people, so decentralization is the safer path - a case that also serves a company looking for a lane. OpenAI ran the opposite play, rationing GPT-5.6-Cyber to firms like Accenture and CrowdStrike days after an OpenClaw agent in Australia found a booking-site vulnerability and bumped a stranger off a waitlist with no way to reverse it. Nvidia's $500 billion financing push turns compute into collateral like a toll road, spreading macro risk across pensions while lowering the barrier for newcomers to build. A new Nature study, modeling 64 scenarios, finds AI pointed at coal, oil, and gas enables up to four times more carbon than its renewable uses avoid - the first number for a category that sat outside every corporate ledger. And Chinese companies accounted for 97% of the world's 19,100 humanoid-robot shipments, according to Smart Analytics, tripling in a year.
